SPECIAL MEETING
  AGENDA
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  SPECIAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEETING

  VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE*

  February 16, 2022 - 4:00 P.M.

Meeting Location: VIA VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE

**DUE TO THE EVOLVING SITUATION WITH THE COVID-19 NOVEL CORONAVIRUS AND HEALTH
ORDERS FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AND L.A. COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT, THE
CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS SPECIAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEETING SHALL ONLY BE
AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC REMOTELY.**

PLEASE NOTE THAT IN LIGHT OF AB 361, THE SPECIAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEETING IS
BEING CONDUCTED AS A VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE MEETING ONLY. MEMBERS OF
THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE VIRTUALLY USING THE ZOOM PLATFORM.

  THE MEETING CAN BE VIEWED AT ZOOM LINK BELOW:

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86377393310?pwd=ak01VDFyL1pOT21RbmU0djFSdnBYdz09

  Meeting ID: 863 7739 3310

  A. ROLL CALL OF COMMITTEE MEMBERS

  •  Steve Gomez, Recreation Director
  •  Juan Serrano, Recreation Supervisor
  •  Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
  •  Jesse Alvarado, Councilmember

  B. PUBLIC COMMENTS

  This is the time reserved for those in the zoom audience to address the Special Events
  Committee regarding any subject. (Time Limit: Maximum of three (3) minutes per speaker; total

  C. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  1. Discussion on City of Hawaiian Gardens Anniversary Carnival event.

  D. NEW BUSINESS

  E. ADJOURNMENT
  Adjourn to the next Special Events Committee meeting, to be determined.
